title: Page 153
transc:
Jno Homer N. Y.  Washn Aug 13th 1864 
Growl Aug Fever Imogene For Robt Murray Esq
NS Marshal Frog Detain the Princess and
her cargo for further orders yoke Wm H
Benard Bunyan zebra another Imogene to Hiram Burney
Collect or France zodiac Detain Schooner Princess and
with aid of NS Man shall examine 
her cargo and nick youth Geo Harrington Acting
Barnard Let the Boston message go forward when
these two have had time to take effect


Beckwith City Pt (No 2)  Wash. D. C. Aug. 13. 1864 9.30 P. M.
happy Rosalie Hudson crowd I presume the Wayne asked
for by Lantern was the Brooks Bengal pearl Whistler 
---- Boards are sent to examine hospls as fast as 
we can get Surgeons pike Spring inspections are being made
by local Surgeons tulip The extreme heat has had
a very bad effect upon the sick in hospls yard
all widows under mystic not actually Shylock Indian campaign 
were repeated to fortune & special inspection made of
his Quotient yacht a new demand for wharf wherry
from adorn & fears Expressed of an humble to
release Samples of war wily lady Rained nicely tonight
